Design Associate/Intermediate Architect
				
DANIEL FRISCH ARCHITECTURE  is hiring a Design Associate/Intermediate Architect to lead the day-to-day work on residential projects both in and out of the city, from design development through construction. You will work directly with the firm partners, clients, consultants and contractors, and take on increasing ownership of your own projects.
DFA provides a unique, sophisticated and engaging work environment in the heart of Manhattan and values the contribution of every member of the team. DFA is growing and offers the opportunity to grow with the firm dependent upon the employee’s personal abilities, interests and motivation.
Ideal Qualifications:
- 3 to 5 years of professional experience, including residential work in New York City.
- Bachelor of Architecture or Master of Architecture from an accredited program.
- Proficiency in Vectorworks, including 2D drafting, 3D modeling, sheet layers and viewports.
- Working knowledge of the NYC Building Code and the DOB filing and review process.
- Experience producing complete construction documents and coordinating them with consultants.
- Clear writing and communication skills for clients, contractors and consultants.
- Ability to manage several projects and deadlines at once.
- Passion for residential design.
Responsibilities:
You will carry projects through each phase of design and construction:
Develop schematic design and design development drawings with the partners and clients.
- Prepare construction documents, details, schedules and specifications in Vectorworks.
- Prepare alteration packages for co-op and condo boards and managing agents, and respond to their engineers’ reviews.
- Prepare drawing sets for NYC Department of Buildings, Landmarks Preservation Commission review, or other local reviewing agencies.
- Consult with structural, MEP and other consultants, and coordinate their drawings with the architectural set.
- Help clients select finishes, fixtures and equipment, and track their decisions.
- Support contractor bidding, including bid review and leveling.
- Handle construction administration: site visits, RFIs, submittal review, field reports and punch lists.
- Keep clients informed on schedule, scope and cost, and flag issues early.
Position:
- Type: Full-time
- Salary range: $65k-$75k based on experience.
- Benefits: Health insurance, 401k matching, paid time off, ARE exam fees
Ability to commute to mid-town Manhattan required.
 
Please email a letter of interest with resume and examples of work to [email protected] for consideration.
